title: Hearty Uruguayan Baby Aubergine Grill
description: A plant-based Uruguayan dish featuring tender baby aubergines, this recipe is perfect for a summer evening, with the grilled aubergines showcasing a smoky and slightly sweet flavor.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the baby aubergines to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Grill the aubergines for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and lightly charred.
While the aubergines are grilling, prepare the chimichurri sauce according to package instructions.
Once the aubergines are done, brush them with chimichurri sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with additional chimichurri sauce on the side, if desired.
